experience.title: Early blight on tomatoes
experience.description: My tomato leaves have brown spots with rings like a target and the bottom leaves are turning yellow and falling off.
experience.what_worked: It was early blight. I pulled off the spotted lower leaves, put straw mulch down so soil stopped splashing up, and switched to watering at the base in the morning. New growth came in clean within two weeks.

experience.title: Sugarcane aphids on sorghum
experience.description: The sorghum leaves are sticky and shiny and there are tiny yellow bugs all under the leaves. Some leaves are going black.
experience.what_worked: Sugarcane aphids. The county agent counted them with me and we treated only once they passed the threshold. Next season I planted a tolerant hybrid earlier and had far fewer.

experience.title: Cotton root rot patches
experience.description: Cotton plants are wilting all at once in round patches, leaves stay hanging on the dead plants.
experience.what_worked: Cotton root rot. Nothing saved the patch that year. I mapped the dead circles, rotated those spots to sorghum, and the extension office helped me plan a treatment at planting for the next cotton crop.

experience.title: Stripe rust on wheat
experience.description: My wheat has yellow orange stripes of powder running along the leaves and it rubs off on my jeans.
experience.what_worked: Stripe rust. I caught it before the flag leaf was hit, and the agent confirmed treating was worth it for my yield. I now plant a resistant variety and check after cool wet weeks.

experience.title: Fall armyworm in young corn
experience.description: Something is chewing ragged holes in the corn whorl and there is wet sawdust looking stuff in it.
experience.what_worked: Fall armyworm. I checked 20 plants in five spots to see how many were hit. It was under the level where spraying pays, and the plants grew out of it. I scout weekly now when the plants are young.

experience.title: Citrus greening in orange trees
experience.description: Orange tree leaves are blotchy yellow, not even on both sides, and the fruit is small, lopsided and stays green at the bottom.
experience.what_worked: The university lab tested a leaf sample and confirmed citrus greening. I removed the infected tree, and I now manage psyllids on the rest with my neighbours on the same schedule.

experience.title: Pecan scab on leaves and shucks
experience.description: Black spots on my pecan leaves and on the shucks, and nuts are dropping early.
experience.what_worked: Pecan scab. I thinned the lower limbs to get more air through, cleaned up old shucks, and followed the extension spray calendar after rainy spells. Much lighter the next year.

experience.title: Heat and water stress in sorghum
experience.description: Sorghum leaves rolling up tight in the afternoon and the edges are burnt, heads are small.
experience.what_worked: It was heat and water stress, not a disease. I left more stubble on the ground to hold moisture and lowered my planting rate the next season.

experience.title: Leaf spot on peanuts
experience.description: Peanut leaves have dark round spots with a yellow halo and the leaves are dropping.
experience.what_worked: Leaf spot. I had planted peanuts in the same field three years running. Rotating to a grass crop for two years and starting protection earlier fixed most of it.

experience.title: Rice blast after heavy nitrogen
experience.description: Diamond shaped grey spots on the rice leaves and some of the heads are white and empty.
experience.what_worked: Rice blast. I had put on too much nitrogen and let the field dry down. Keeping the flood steady and splitting nitrogen helped, and I changed to a more resistant variety.

experience.title: Spider mites on tomatoes
experience.description: Tomato leaves have tiny pale dots and fine webbing underneath, the leaves look dusty and bronze.
experience.what_worked: Spider mites, worse because it was hot and dusty. I hosed the undersides of the leaves every few days and stopped the broad spray that was killing the helpful bugs.

experience.title: Nitrogen shortage in corn after rain
experience.description: Lower corn leaves are yellow in a V shape starting from the tip, the plants are short and pale.
experience.what_worked: Nitrogen shortage after heavy rain washed it out. A soil test confirmed it. I side-dressed once and now split my nitrogen instead of putting it all on at planting.

experience.title: Bollworms in cotton bolls
experience.description: Small holes in the cotton bolls and squares are falling off, I see little worms inside.
experience.what_worked: Bollworms. I learned to check 100 plants across the field for eggs and small worms, and to act early because the big ones are hard to stop.

experience.title: Thrips on onions
experience.description: Onion leaves have silvery white streaks and the tips are drying, tiny thin insects down in the neck.
experience.what_worked: Thrips. Overhead watering knocked them back some, and I stopped planting next to my neighbour's old onion field where they were coming from.
